shot_editor_decisions.editorial_reason: Historical U.S. inquiry photograph visibly establishes eyewitness testimony and later investigation rather than illustrative document cards; caption U.S. Senate committee, May 1912
Authentic September 1911 shipyard image for discussion of design and shipbuilding; cannot suggest it shows voyage night
Genuine Belfast construction image to complement narrator's shipyard reference; use specific framing of two ships, no fabricated hull diagrams
First-class shipboard service artifact replaces generic class accommodation diagram where script discusses first-class amenities; explicitly label menu dated Apr 10
Actual third-class passenger artifact may illustrate passengers' lived experience, but narration centers on passenger manifest; CONDITIONAL: rewrite selected visual beat, otherwise leave blocked
Authentic ship plan amended later with lifeboat labels: use as labelled historical-plan-derived diagram, NOT counted authentic photo
Detailed deck layout relevant to precise lifeboat preparation and locations; explain annotations later
Contemporary 1912 family survivor photograph directly supports named lives versus abstract rates; do not invent identities
Photograph of the actual Carpathia captain and officers connects to description of rescue crew; label AFTER RESCUE, not active preparation
Original April 1912 newspaper front page (photo taken 1958) to illustrate early reporting and imperfect totals; clear date caption
Real White Star office photograph to illustrate family search for information, not Carpathia docking
Different editorial use of same real office image: family inquiries and aftermath; repeated adjacent? inspect before final
Authentic survivor photo precisely matches narrator's reflection on surviving images; separate from previous class statistic location
1912 U.S. inquiry photograph to bridge rescue and formal investigations; label U.S. Senate not UK inquiry
U.S. Titanic Senate inquiry photograph directly depicts investigations, with dated caption
Different authentic contemporary inquiry photograph supports witness-hearing passage
Real May 1912 witness committee photo for discussion of investigation limits; source title needs identity verification
Actual contemporary inquiry photograph rather than fake stylized testimony pages; deliberately revisit with closer composition
Only acceptable if the visual beat discusses operator survival/aftermath; current voice describes operators transmitting, so BLOCK AS MISMATCH
Actual portrait of Arthur Rostron supports naming rescue captain, independent source from current existing Rostron photo
